name: set up an R Jupyter kernel plus the R analysis packages for causal work
definition: Install/register the R Jupyter kernel and the R graph/data-frame packages required for causal analysis.
failure_mode: No IRkernel, kernelspec missing, or kernel name not detected.

name: split oversized files to respect a size limit
definition: When a single source record exceeds the byte cap, fragment it into several chunks that each fit within the limit while remaining recoverable.
failure_mode: An oversized resulting file or a split that cannot be reassembled fails the round trip.

name: stay beneath a compressed source-size ceiling
definition: keep the source so small that its gzip-compressed size respects a hard byte cap and does not communicate the image data by embedding the pixel content.
failure_mode: exceeding the cap by embedding pixels fails the size gate

name: train a fasttext classifier to accuracy and size targets
definition: Fit a fasttext text classifier on labeled review data, choosing data use and hyperparameters so it generalizes to a target holdout accuracy while staying within a serialized-size budget.
failure_mode: Under-fit model falls below the accuracy threshold
